attempts.summary: Configured zram-init on node1 (Alpine 3.23) to provide 1024 MB of zstd-compressed in-memory swap, enabled in the OpenRC boot runlevel, with swap priority 100 (well above the default -1/unset priority a disk-backed swap would use). Requirement of at least 512 MB, active at boot, and preferred over disk-backed swap is satisfied. Verified the configuration survives a full node restart with a changed boot identity.
